from pocket_coffea.workflows.base_processor import BaseProcessor
import awkward as ak
import numpy as np

class DimuonAnalysisProcessor(BaseProcessor):
    """Minimal dimuon analysis processor"""
    
    def object_preselection(self, events):
        """Build MuonGood collection with kinematic cuts"""
        muon_good = (events.Muon.pt > 15) & (np.abs(events.Muon.eta) < 2.4)
        events["MuonGood"] = events.Muon[muon_good]
        return events
    
    def object_counting(self, events):
        """Store number of selected muons per event"""
        events["nMuonGood"] = ak.count(events.MuonGood.pt, axis=1)
        return events
